sources.title: GitHub - vexth-git/breast-mnist-classifier
sources.snippet: Overview This repository contains a deep learning project focused on the binary classification of breast ultrasound images (benign vs. malignant) using the BreastMNIST dataset. The objective is to improve upon baseline models for medical image analysis using a customized convolutional neural network.

sources.title: MedMNIST
sources.snippet: Abstract We introduce MedMNIST, a large-scale MNIST-like collection of standardized biomedical images, including 12 datasets for 2D and 6 datasets for 3D. All images are pre-processed into 28x28 (2D) or 28x28x28 (3D) with the corresponding classification labels, so that no background knowledge is required for users.
